title: Settle the DeepSeek default model and add a no-credit key state
goal: config/config.default.json defaults DeepSeek to deepseek-chat but the live /models list shows deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro; a chat probe was blocked by insufficient balance. Once the account has credit, confirm with one 1-token request per model, fix the bundled default (and the retired-model remap in susi-vendor-models cloud.rs), and make keys check distinguish 'valid but out of credit'. Add tests named deepseek_default_is_served_* (offline: assert the default is in the remap's served set).
